description: This file contains helper functions for ASN.1 encoding of CSI measurement configuration data, including mapping resource configurations, generating ASN.1 structures, and computing configuration differences. It references various ASN.1 utils and 3GPP specifications related to CSI reporting in 5G NR.

methods.name: make_asn1_nzp_csi_rs_resource_mapping
methods.description: Converts a resource mapping configuration into ASN.1 format, handling different frequency domain bitmap sizes and port counts.

methods.name: make_asn1_csi_resource_periodicity_and_offset
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 structure for CSI resource periodicity and offset based on periodicity enum and offset value.

methods.name: make_asn1_zp_csi_rs_resource
methods.description: Generates ASN.1 structure for zero-power CSI-RS resource.

methods.name: make_asn1_zp_csi_rs_resource_set
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 structure for a set of zero-power CSI-RS resources.

methods.name: make_asn1_nzp_csi_rs_resource
methods.description: Converts a non-zero power CSI-RS resource into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: make_asn1_nzp_csi_rs_resource_set
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 structure for a set of non-zero power CSI-RS resources.

methods.name: make_asn1_csi_im_resource
methods.description: Converts a CSI-IM resource configuration into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: make_asn1_csi_im_resource_set
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 structure for a set of CSI-IM resources.

methods.name: make_asn1_csi_ssb_resource_set
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 structure for a set of SSB resources.

methods.name: make_asn1_csi_resource_config
methods.description: Converts CSI resource configuration into ASN.1 structure.

methods.name: make_asn1_csi_report_config
methods.description: Generates ASN.1 report configuration structure from internal configuration data.

methods.name: make_asn1_aperiodic_trigger_state
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 structure for an aperiodic trigger state.

methods.name: make_asn1_semi_persistent_on_pusch_trigger_state
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 structure for semi-persistent on PUSCH trigger state.

methods.name: calculate_csi_meas_config_diff
methods.description: Computes differences between two CSI measurement configurations and outputs ASN.1 diff structure.
